name: nefrotrack
description: NefroTrack — Centros de Hemodiálisis, Reuso de Capilares (FFV >= 80%), Ósmosis Inversa & Módulos PAMI/INCUCAI

scripts.version:bump: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json', 'utf8')); const [maj, min, patch] = v.version.replace('v', '').split('.').map(Number); const nextPatch = String(patch + 1).padStart(2, '0'); const semver = maj + '.' + min + '.' + nextPatch; v.version = 'v' + semver; v.build = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '') + '.1'; v.releaseDate = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); v.cacheName = 'nefrotrack-cache-' + v.version; fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) + '\n'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.version = semver; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); const sw = fs.readFileSync('sw.js', 'utf8').replace(/const CACHE_NAME = '[^']+';/, 'const CACHE_NAME = \'' + v.cacheName + '\';'); fs.writeFileSync('sw.js', sw); console.log('Bumped to ' + v.version + ' (SW: ' + v.cacheName + ')'); })"
